title: The Tale of Peter Rabbit
description: Peter Rabbit ignores his mother's warning, slips into Mr McGregor's garden and discovers that stealing vegetables is much easier than escaping with them.
catalogueBlurb: Peter Rabbit sneaks into a forbidden garden and has to find his way home.

cover.alt: Beatrix Potter's original 1902 cover illustration for The Tale of Peter Rabbit.

text.source: Original Story House retelling based on Beatrix Potter's public-domain 1902 story
text.notes: The underlying 1902 story is public domain. This wording is an original child-friendly Unicorn Valley retelling.

illustrations.notes: The selected original Potter illustration files are identified as public domain on Wikimedia Commons.

rights.curatorNotes: A short classic split into five scene-sized reader sections, retaining Potter's original visual identity.

text.source: Beatrix Potter's 1902 text, transcribed in Project Gutenberg eBook #14838
text.notes: Complete story text. Project Gutenberg header, footer, licence text and standalone [Illustration] placeholders are excluded; wording is not abridged or modernised.

illustrations.source: Original 1902 illustrations by Beatrix Potter, Project Gutenberg eBook #14838
illustrations.notes: All 26 narrative illustrations appearing between the opening story text and THE END in the Project Gutenberg HTML edition are included in source order. Story House pagination changes presentation only.

edition.notes: Story House pagination is presentation only; the original wording remains unabridged.

rights.curatorNotes: Complete original text reflowed into 10 reader pages at paragraph boundaries, with all 26 narrative illustrations from the Project Gutenberg 1902 edition restored at their matching passage anchors.
